51494-beach-scene.title: Beach Scene
51494-beach-scene.creator: Unknown
51494-beach-scene.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It seemed that everyone except him had seen the wonders of the beach country. The stories he had heard from his brothers and their friends had taunted him for as long as he could remember. So many times had he heard these thrilling tales that now, as he ran along, he could clearly picture the wonderland as though he were already there.

arxiv-2002-06628.title: Modeling Citation Trajectories of Scientific Papers
arxiv-2002-06628.creator: Dattatreya Mohapatra, Siddharth Pal, Soham De, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Tanmoy Chakraborty
arxiv-2002-06628.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Dattatreya Mohapatra, Siddharth Pal, Soham De, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Tanmoy Chakraborty. Several network growth models have been proposed in the literature that attempt to incorporate properties of citation networks. Generally, these models aim at retaining the degree distribution observed in real-world networks. In this work, we explore whether existing network growth models can realize the diversity in citation growth exhibited by individual papers – a new node-centric property observed recently in citation networks across multiple domains of research.

arxiv-2108-03080.title: Lighthill equation for quantum liquids
arxiv-2108-03080.creator: C. Dedes
arxiv-2108-03080.description: Abstract A quantum version of the Lighthill equation that originated in the field of theoretical aeroacoustics is derived for the probability density of a superfluid starting from the time-dependent Gross-Pitaevskii equation. It involves a second-order time derivative and should be supplemented by two-time boundary conditions.

arxiv-2411-12254.title: Predicting User Intents and Musical Attributes from Music Discovery Conversations
arxiv-2411-12254.creator: Daeyong Kwon, SeungHeon Doh, Juhan Nam
arxiv-2411-12254.description: Abstract Intent classification is a text understanding task that identifies user needs from input text queries. While intent classification has been extensively studied in various domains, it has not received much attention in the music domain. In this paper, we investigate intent classification models for music discovery conversation , focusing on pre-trained language models.

arxiv-2507-13910.title: PARK: Personalized Academic Retrieval with Knowledge-graphs Journal: Information Systems
arxiv-2507-13910.creator: Pranav Kasela, Gabriella Pasi, Raffaele Perego
arxiv-2507-13910.description: Abstract Academic Search is a search task aimed to manage and retrieve scientific documents like journal articles and conference papers. Personalization in this context meets individual researchers’ needs by leveraging, through user profiles, the user related information (e.g. documents authored by a researcher), to improve search effectiveness and to reduce the information overload.

Their town or district is called Larissa and is fertile, and they are celebrated for their spearmanship.

pmc-11331480.title: Identification of circulating microRNA-126-3p as a new biomarker for coronary artery calcification
pmc-11331480.creator: Xia Zhang, Mengmeng Zhu, Peng Zeng, Mingxiu Guan, Hongyu Zhang, Shaohua Duan, Heli Huang, Yulian Liu, Hongliang Cong, Yuanli Chen
pmc-11331480.description: Objective:Several circulating microRNAs, including microRNA-126-3p, have been identified as diagnostic and prognostic biomarker of cardiovascular disease. However, whether microRNA-126-3p is an independent risk predictor for coronary artery calcification is unclear.Methods:In this prospective single-center study, we collected blood samples from coronary artery atherosclerosis patients (n = 54), patients with coronary artery calcification (n = 33) and controls (n = 56).

pmc-11394553.title: Maternal Supplementation with Dietary Betaine during Late Gestation Increased Ewe Plasma Creatine and Lamb Thermoregulation under Field Conditions
pmc-11394553.creator: Billie-Jaye Brougham, Alice C. Weaver, Alyce M. Swinbourne, Megan R. Tscharke, Amy L. Munn, Jennifer M. Kelly, David O. Kleemann, William H. E. J. van Wettere
pmc-11394553.description: Simple SummaryPerinatal twin lamb mortality reduces productivity and reproductive efficiency in Australian sheep meat and wool enterprises. This study investigated whether supplementing 4 g of betaine into the diets of twin-bearing Merino ewes during late pregnancy would improve lamb viability measures and survival to weaning under field conditions.

pmc-12495329.title: The activity of the EMT suppressor GRHL2 is regulated by SUMOylation
pmc-12495329.creator: Sonja Santjer, Yang Xu, Sabine Riethdorf, Gerhard Schön, Johanna Neu, Klaus Pantel, Volker Assmann
pmc-12495329.description: The developmental transcription factor grainyhead-like 2 (GRHL2) has been attributed both tumor-suppressive and protumorigenic functions in a large variety of human cancers. Despite its fundamental role in cancer development and progression, mechanisms modulating expression or activity of GRHL2 in cancer cells still remain elusive.

pmc-12613026.title: Complete replantation of a small tissue segment at the auricular apex: A case report
pmc-12613026.creator: Haiyuan Han, Longxin An, Jie Zhao, Xuecheng Sun, Futian Zhang, Naibo Feng
pmc-12613026.description: This study reports a rare case of complete replantation of a small avulsed tissue segment at the auricular apex. The patient, a 30-year-old male, sustained a complete amputation of the left ear apex due to a traffic accident. The avulsed tissue had been ischemic for approximately 4 h prior to surgery.

pmc-12625441.title: Comorbidities among women presenting for obstetric care in Uganda
pmc-12625441.creator: Leevan Tibaijuka, Adeline A Boatin, Asiphas Owaraganise, Lisa M Bebell, Musa Kayondo, Mark J Siedner, Francis Bajunirwe, Yarine Farjardo Tornes, Joseph Ngonzi
pmc-12625441.description: BackgroundMaternal mortality rates are high in low- and middle-income countries, with Uganda’s ratio at 189 deaths per 100,000 live births. Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) account for 15% of indirect maternal deaths worldwide. We examined medical comorbidities during pregnancy at Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital (MRRH) in south-western Uganda.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional study at MRRH from January to December 2022.

pmc-13411360.title: Development of Sub‐50 nm Core–Shell Silica Nanoparticles With Controlled In Vivo Behavior for 19F Magnetic Resonance Imaging
pmc-13411360.creator: Yue Wu, Masafumi Minoshima, Kazuya Kikuchi
pmc-13411360.description: 19F magnetic resonance imaging (19F MRI) enables quantitative and background‐free detection, but its inherently low sensitivity demands probes with high fluorine density and favorable pharmacokinetics. Perfluorocarbon (PFC)‐encapsulated nanoparticles are a promising class of 19F MRI probes that demonstrate high 19F MR sensitivity. However, their relatively large size (usually over 70 nm) results in slow hepatic clearance and limited tumor accumulation.

pmc-13414125.title: A nature-based intervention for bereaved friend and family cancer caregivers: a study protocol
pmc-13414125.creator: Rebecca Lehto, Arienne Patano, Zhehui Luo, Jason Moser, Esra’a Sawalmeh, Gwen Wyatt
pmc-13414125.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Friend and/or family caregivers (FCGs) of those with terminal cancer are heavily relied upon to address the emotional and physical needs of the patient facing death. Although increasing research has focused on testing supportive interventions for FCGs who deliver home-based care at end of life, limited attention has targeted strategies that support grief processing for bereaved FCGs during the months following the patients’ death.

pmc-13522963.title: Early Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitor Use After Acute Kidney Injury in Type 2 Diabetes
pmc-13522963.creator: Yu-Ting Chou, Jui-Yi Chen, Zheng-Hong Jiang, Li-Chun Lin, Vin-Cent Wu
pmc-13522963.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Key PointsQuestionWhat outcomes are associated with a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT-2) inhibitor prescription within 30 days vs 31 to 90 days after discharge among adults with type 2 diabetes recovering from dialysis-requiring acute kidney injury?FindingsIn this cohort study using a target trial emulation design in 4406 patients, early SGLT-2 inhibitor prescription was associated with a lower risk of adverse kidney events after propensity score matching, with no significant differences in mortality or major adverse cardiovascular events.MeaningThese findings support timely initiation of SGLT-2 inhibitors

pmc-13529809.title: Digital music intervention and music therapy across the dementia care continuum: Randomized controlled trial
pmc-13529809.creator: Lotta M. Kaila, Ilja Salakka, Anni Pitkäniemi, Sari Laitinen, Milla Holma, Aleksi J. Sihvonen, Teppo Särkämö
pmc-13529809.description: INTRODUCTIONMusic interventions show promise in dementia care and digital approaches may increase availability and accessibility. We investigated the efficacy of a digital music intervention (DMI) and conventional music therapy (CMT) compared to standard care (SC) across the dementia care continuum.

pmc-13559187.title: Therapeutic consequence of adrenal venous sampling complication: remission of primary aldosteronism after adrenal vein thrombosis
pmc-13559187.creator: Navjot Kaur Grewal, Colin Carracher, Andrew Welch, Yiyang Lu
pmc-13559187.description: A 43-year-old man with resistant hypertension and hypokalemia was diagnosed with primary aldosteronism (PA), confirmed by biochemical testing and adrenal vein sampling (AVS), which lateralized aldosterone secretion to the right adrenal gland. Shortly after AVS, he developed right flank pain, and imaging showed mild postprocedural changes without overt complications.

pmc-13560190.title: Using evidence briefs to support future implementation planning: the case of early fibrinolysis for myocardial infarction and rehabilitation for the amputee patient in Colombia
pmc-13560190.creator: Marcela Vélez, Viviana Vélez-Marín, Luz Helena Lugo-Agudelo, Daniel Felipe Patiño Lugo, Pamela Velásquez-Salazar, Luisa Fernanda Mesa Franco, Claudia Yaneth Vera-Giraldo, Juan Carlos Velásquez-Correa, Christine Fahim, Robert Marten, Sonam Yangchen, Sharon Straus
pmc-13560190.description: BackgroundDespite the relevance of clinical practice guidelines for health policy development, planning, evaluation and quality improvement, implementation of the Colombian national guidelines is still in early stages. The objective of this study was to develop two evidence briefs supporting future development of implementation plans.MethodsWe involved Colombian Ministry of Health representatives in dialogues about prioritizing recommendations for implementation.
